summary: An introduction to colour and Emotionally Freedom Technique (EFT) tapping. Discover how the spiritual psychology of colour and EFT (tapping) work together to help you release old patterns that limit your health, wealth, relationships, confidence and overall wellbeing.
description:
Discover how the spiritual psychology of colour and EFT (tapping) work together to help you release old patterns that limit your health, wealth, relationships, confidence and overall wellbeing. This introductory evening offers simple yet powerful tools that support real change in a gentle and practical  way.

About the event

👉 What would you most like to change in your life?

👉 Your health, wealth, relationships or career?

Maybe you want to let go of the stress you carry, overcome a fear of public speaking or finally release hurt, pain (physical/emotional) or resentment that has stayed with you for years.  We all carry patterns that shape the way we behave and influence the choices we make. Many of these patterns come from childhood influences such as parents and teachers. Some are inherited through our family line. Beliefs such as I’m not good/pretty/clever enough, I don’t deserve it, or I can’t speak up because people won’t like me quietly affect everything from confidence to relationships to abundance. The life that we subconsciously create for ourselves is a mirror of the patterns and beliefs that we carry. Just imagine what your life could look like if you no longer took these beliefs as truth!

Colour 🌈

Colour analysis uses the spiritual psychology of colour to identify the deeper patterns that subconsciously guide and impact your life. The colour bottles used work directly with your energy field and bypass the conscious mind. Colour supports you in clearing blocks, releasing emotional weight and resistance so you can move forward with more clarity.

EFT (Emotional Freedom Technique) 🤏

EFT or tapping is a simple technique that uses the body’s meridian points, similar to acupressure. By tapping these points with your fingertips you activate the body’s natural ability to heal and restore balance to the body's system. Tapping allows you to take your physical wellbeing into your hands and helps reduce stress, anxiety, emotional tension and physical discomfort.

Colour + EFT Together

When colour and EFT are combined the effect is deeply supportive. They allow you to work on your wellbeing in a safe and empowering way. Colour highlights the pattern. Colour & EFT together then help unblock any resistance and clear those patterns. Together they bring awareness, release and a sense of renewed possibility. Once you understand your pattern you can choose to keep running it or let it go. You become the author of what comes next.

What to Expect

The session lasts approximately 90 minutes.  No experience needed. A welcoming and relaxed atmosphere. Gentle guidance and space to explore and let go of the patterns and beliefs that no longer (and maybe never did!) support you.

💫  What you free within you transforms the world around you. 💫

summary: Gather over a warm bowl of soup for mindful conversations on end-of-life preparation. Inspired by the "parent tree" metaphor, we’ll explore how our final wishes can nourish the community we leave behind. This 6-month series rotates through three core themes—join us for 1 or all 3 topics.
description:
Topic:  Dying + The Mindful Caregiver

What if we became curious about creating our ending? In this mindful evening workshop, we’ll gather around the table over soup to contemplate the ways in which we can prepare for our death. Using mindfulness & meditation, an imagery exercise, and guided reflection, Amanda will lead the group through conscious conversation on what we might want and what we can expect in our end-of-life experience.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_6c8b5fc1d52a4bad914d31305632dba4~mv2.jpg)

People who engage in contemplating the end of their lives often have less anxiety when the aging process begins. This workshop creates a supportive environment to explore the curiosity, fear, and possibilities of the end. We encourage active involvement through group sharing and will bring connection in the group, empowering you to:

- Engage your family and community in your preparation process
- Craft wishes for your end-of-life care
- Provide  preparatory exercises and contemplative tools to carry into your daily life

If you’ve hiked through a giant Redwood forest in California, you may find yourself in the middle of a fairy ring of majestic trees. When a Redwood tree is struck down by logging, lightning, or fire, a ring of young trees will grow around the trunk of the tree, drawing from the root system of the parent tree. As the parent tree breaks down, it returns to the soil, continuing to nourish the next generation of trees.

This discussion uses the metaphor of the "parent tree" to explore how to feed the younger trees by doing the steps that are necessary now in order to help create a fairy ring of trees that will help you at the end of your life, and live on to support this lineage beyond your death.

This evening is intended to nourish the soil of your life in order to nourish the soil of life beyond you.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_c64012f298fd469d850833c00b01da89~mv2.png)

Amanda Coggin has led death awareness conversations for the last 15 years in Buddhist hospice work and as a hospital chaplain in San Francisco, California.  She is leading this series of talks discussing various aspects of the dying process with the aim of bringing awareness to this important topic that has been largely left unspoken in the past. We hope these discussions will support and prepare the community for the dying process.

summary: Ready to build your family’s natural medicine chest? Join our free learning series at The Hague Natural Health Centre to master tissue salts, flower essences & homeopathic first aid with Homeopath and Energy Medicine Practitioner, Sandra Quist.
description:
Empower Your Family’s Health with Natural Remedies

Take control of your family's wellness with safe, gentle, and easy-to-use natural remedies. Join us for a relaxed, educational series designed to equip parents and individuals with practical tools to support the body and mind naturally.

Your host is Sandra Quist, a Homeopath and Energy Medicine Practitioner with over 12 years of teaching experience including 7 years of clinical experience. This informal workshop series aims to provide people with a basic understanding of natural remedies so that they do not feel so mysterious. We aim to have fun so bring your questions no matter how silly or serious they might be!

### What You Will Learn

The series is divided into 3 modules, each focusing on a different way of approaching health via physical symptoms, emotional symptoms and most often both at the same time. Although each module can stand alone, it is recommended that you join at least two of the same modules in order to give you a strong understanding of feeling confident to begin using them on your own. It is the first time we host this learning series at the Natural Health Centre so the timing and content may vary slightly depending on the audience and pace of questions.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8b90ae_a5d96a9632bb44ff8481f8f18b4c1717~mv2.png)

#### Oct 19 & Nov 16:

#### Introduction to Schuessler Tissue Salts 
(Physical Body Support)

Learn how these 12 essential mineral salts support physical functions and help manage everyday ailments. Tissue Salts are bascially energetic versions of electrolytes. This workshop covers:

- What are tissue salts and why they are vital to cellular health.
- The 12 core tissue salts and common combination remedies,
- Practical tools for common conditions: colds, minor asthma support, bedwetting, chickenpox, measles, colic, cramps, fevers, hemorrhoids, hair loss, hay fever, and brain fog.

#### Dec 7 & Jan 11:

#### Flower Essences (Emotional Balance)

Discover gentle flower remedies designed to support emotional well-being and stress management.

- Fundamentals of flower essences and how they are prepared.
- Practical applications of traditional Bach Flower Essences.
- Introduction to pre-combined flower essences for quick and easy daily use.

#### Feb 8:

#### Homeopathic First Aid (Acute Care)

Introduction to the basics of homeopathy and managing everyday injuries, acute illnesses, and sudden stresses.

- Core principles and philosophy behind homeopathic remedies.
- How to select and administer remedies for colds, emotional distress, minor injuries, sunburn, food poisoning, grief, and more.
- There's so much you can do to support your family with natural remedies, start to learn about it!

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3d01ac_679501fba6b24163a9402644af9c3014~mv2.png)

### Prerequisites & Attendance

- Registration Required: This is a free event, however due to limited capacity, you must register for each event. We also ask that you kindly cancel your attendance if you are unable to attend in order to allow someone else to take your place.
- Who it’s for: Open to everyone, especially mothers, fathers, and caregivers looking to educate themselves on natural health. No prior experience is required, just an open and curious mind.
- Format: You are welcome to attend individual sessions as your schedule allows. However, to get the most value and to participate in Q&A sessions, we strongly recommend attending both months of a specific topic (e.g., both Tissue Salt modules).
The intention is to have fun, ask questions, let your curiosty lead you to learn something new that can actually support you and your family in a natural, sustainable and non-invasive way.
